payload.title: CLI fails closed: no silent AWS credential fallback
payload.description: graphql_request_headers (src/papyrus_content/graphql_http.py) signs with the AWS credential chain when no user session file exists and PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH is unset. Make the signed-in user the default: with no session, refuse and say to run papyrus login. IAM only on an explicit opt-in, for workers and the listed break-glass commands. Update the error guidance in operator_errors.py and cli_user_auth.py that tells people to set AWS_PROFILE. Check every worker and scheduled job that relies on the default sets the opt-in before this ships. Gherkin required.
